The in-process unit test fixture _make_test_harness() in services/training-session/tests/test_teaching_evaluation_readback.py (lines 67-97) only stubbed harness._persona_headers and set PANTHEON_L12_TRAINING_TOKEN, causing 3 tests in test_teaching_evaluation_readback.py to fail with BoundaryFailure: PANTHEON_L12_OPERATOR_TOKEN is not set by the isolated harness.

No code change to scripts/git/auto_integrator.py is warranted.
